runtime_uncertainties: The local reviewed source packet must establish a stationary-rail carrier other than a streetcar, an at-grade crossing, highway status, live map and centerline before Native mutation.
Original leading-body to reviewed near-edge station is an engineering reference; 100 feet remains statutory, and exact boundary interpretation remains legal review.
The 0.25-foot source-sample engineering tolerance tests whether a target was reached; it is not a legal threshold.
Actual CARLA motion, rail crossing geometry and four-view visibility require local original capture and independent review.
Offline, positive/negative compatibility, semantic, saved delivery and comparison audit receipts remain worker-owned CPU work.

required_context: Declare crossing extent as a construction assumption; locate the centerline and retain approach, traversal and vehicle-footprint geometry.
Establish a carrier of persons or property on stationary rails other than streetcars, with the highway crossing at grade.
Establish highway status, two-way operation and an ordinary motor vehicle under this driver's actual physical control.
Establish qualifying highway and vehicle status, driver actual physical control and two-way operation.
Establish stationary rails used by a carrier of persons or property other than streetcars and a crossing at highway grade.
Preserve the statutory 100 feet; crossing boundaries, distance measurement and vehicle reference points remain construction assumptions rather than supplied legal definitions.
Retain centerline, crossing geometry, motion and footprint throughout approach and traversal.
witness_review.reason: The fixed rail crossing supports the railroad branch if it is a railroad grade crossing rather than a streetcar or grade-separated crossing.
